user.title: Connect Spiroflex ecoVENT Simple
user.description: Enter the address of the local ventclear API.

data_description.host: IP address or hostname of the server running ventclear.
data_description.port: HTTP port exposed by ventclear. The default is 8088.

reconfigure.title: Change Spiroflex connection
reconfigure.description: Enter the new address for the same ventilation unit (for example, the Home Assistant app). Existing devices, entities and automations are preserved. The connection is tested before saving.

data_description.host: New IP address or hostname, without http:// or a port.
data_description.port: REST API port. The default is 8088.

error.cannot_connect: Unable to connect to the Spiroflex API.
error.already_configured: This Spiroflex API is already used by another entry.
error.invalid_host: Enter only the IP address or hostname.

abort.already_configured: This Spiroflex API is already configured.
abort.reconfigure_successful: Spiroflex connection updated. Existing device and entities preserved.
